For this reason we are looking for three-room, four-room and larger apartments in areas such as

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to your questions
faq.studentQ1: Which areas of Turin do you cover?
faq.studentA1: We operate in Turin's most strategic university areas: Vanchiglia, Vanchiglietta and Sassi (near Politecnico and San Salvario area), Lingotto and Ospedali (ideal for UniTo students), Aurora, Cenisia, Cit Turin and Crocetta (well connected to the city center). All our solutions are maximum 20 minutes from the main university campuses by public transport.
faq.studentQ2: What is the average monthly price for a room?
faq.studentA2: The average rent is €490 per month, significantly lower than the €600-700 requested by real estate agencies. This 25-30% saving is possible thanks to our direct model, as we are not a real estate agency. All our prices are transparent with no hidden commission costs.
faq.studentQ3: What does the rent price include?
faq.studentA3: The €490 rent covers the room rental. Utilities (electricity, gas, water, internet, heating) are separate and are divided equally among tenants, with an estimated cost of €80-120 per month per person depending on consumption and season. We always provide a transparent expense report.
faq.studentQ4: What is the minimum contract duration?
faq.studentA4: We offer temporary contracts with study motivation for a minimum duration of 9 months (September-May), aligned with the academic year. This type of contract is specifically designed for university students and guarantees greater flexibility compared to traditional 4+4 contracts, with the possibility of year-by-year renewal.
faq.studentQ5: Is it possible to visit the rooms before booking?
faq.studentA5: Absolutely yes! We organize both in-person visits (if you're already in Turin) and guided video calls for international or out-of-town students. Our team responds within 24 hours to schedule an appointment. You can also request additional photos and videos of common areas and the neighborhood.
faq.studentQ6: Do you accept international students? Are special documents required?
faq.studentA6: Yes, we welcome students from all over the world! Required documents are: Italian university enrollment certificate (also for Erasmus or exchange programs) and valid ID or passport. We provide contracts in Italian and English to ensure full understanding for all our tenants.
faq.investorQ1: What is the minimum investment required?
faq.investorA1: The minimum investment in Jungle Rent starts from €100, allowing access to the Turin real estate market even with limited capital. For those wanting to invest more, opportunities depend on the properties we have available and that we want to acquire.
faq.investorQ2: What kind of returns can I expect?
faq.investorA2: Historical returns have been above the Turin market average, but are not guaranteed and depend on the Turin real estate market trend and occupancy rate. WARNING: this does not constitute a promise of return nor a contractual obligation. Real estate investments involve risks, including possible partial or total loss of invested capital. We always recommend diversifying your portfolio.
faq.investorQ3: Does Jungle Rent manage the property completely?
faq.investorA3: Yes, we offer a full-service management service that includes: tenant search and selection, contract management and registrations, ordinary and extraordinary maintenance, rent collection, arrears management, legal assistance, and detailed quarterly reporting. The investor receives passive income without having to worry about anything.
faq.investorQ4: How long does it take to see the first returns?
faq.investorA4: The first return is paid after approximately 2 months from investment, once the setup phase is completed (purchase/renovation, tenant search, contract registration). Subsequently, returns are distributed quarterly via bank transfer. You will also receive a quarterly report with details of your investment's performance.
faq.investorQ5: What type of contracts are offered to tenants?
faq.investorA5: We use temporary contracts with study motivation (art. 5 L. 431/98) lasting 9-10 months, renewable annually. Contracts are available in Italian and English to ensure full understanding for all tenants. This type was chosen because it's perfectly aligned with student demand, guarantees greater rotation (therefore rent adjustment to market rates) and legal protection for both owner and tenant. All contracts are regularly registered with the Italian Revenue Agency.
faq.generalQ1: Who are you and how long have you been operating?
faq.generalA1: Jungle Rent was born from the direct experience of real estate investors and financial professionals who personally experienced the difficulties of finding housing as students away from home. We have been operating with our own investments for 2 years, and starting from February 2026 we will launch the startup to open investment opportunities to external investors as well. We are partners of 2i3T, the Politecnico di Torino incubator, which validates the solidity of our business model and supports us in strategic growth.
faq.generalA2: You can contact us in several ways: WhatsApp at +39 331 905 3037 (response within 2 hours during business hours), email at junglerententeprise@gmail.com, or by filling out the dedicated forms on the site for students, investors or sellers. Our team speaks Italian and English. The office is at via Gioacchino Quarello 15/A, Turin, and we are available for meetings by appointment.
faq.howItWorksQ1: How can I find and book a room?
faq.howItWorksA1: The process is simple in 4 steps: 1) Browse available rooms on our site filtering by university area, price and preferences. 2) Fill in the interest form indicating your needs. 3) Book directly with your friends or we help you find roommates. 4) Receive the contract via email, sign it digitally and pay the deposit. Everything online, without agency commissions.
faq.howItWorksQ2: What are the steps to sign the contract and pay?
faq.howItWorksA2: Once the room is confirmed: 1) You receive the temporary contract with study motivation via email (available in Italian and English). 2) You sign digitally through a secure platform. 3) You pay the deposit (equivalent to 2 months) via bank transfer or card. 4) We handle the contract registration with the Italian Revenue Agency. Everything is completed in 3-5 business days. Zero commission costs.
faq.howItWorksQ3: How does the move-in and key handover work?
faq.howItWorksA3: We contact you 7-10 days before the agreed check-in date to organize the time. On moving day, a member of our team personally welcomes you at the apartment, hands you the keys, shows you all the spaces and explains how appliances, heating, Wi-Fi work. You sign a handover report with the apartment's condition and you're ready to settle in. The process takes about 30-45 minutes.
faq.howItWorksQ4: How are utilities and condominium fees managed?
faq.howItWorksA4: Utilities (electricity, gas, water, internet, heating) are registered to Jungle Rent and are divided equally among all apartment tenants. Each quarter you receive a detailed report of consumption and expenses incurred, with a payment request for your share. The average estimated cost is €80-120 per month per person. Ordinary condominium fees are included in the rent.
faq.howItWorksQ5: How does support work during your stay?
faq.howItWorksA5: You have access to our support service via WhatsApp 7 days a week. For emergencies (system failures, flooding, security issues) we respond within 2-4 hours and intervene the same day. For non-urgent requests (minor repairs, roommate issues, administrative questions) we respond within 24 hours. We also organize quarterly meetings with all tenants to collect feedback and improve the service.
faq.howItWorksQ6: How does the monthly rent payment work?
faq.howItWorksA6: Monthly rent must be paid by the 5th of the month via bank transfer. You receive an automatic email notification 3 days before the deadline with IBAN and payment reference. You can also set up a standing order with your bank. In case of delay exceeding 10 days, we apply a €50 late fee as per contract. To facilitate management, we also accept advance payments for multiple months.
